**2B.6 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** the public record is **mixed but leaning negative**. I found some genuine de-escalation and official denial/verification language, but the stronger pattern is Khamenei using grievance, power-talk, and threat inflation to mobilize support for conflict. I did **not** find direct evidence that he fabricated intelligence, but I did find repeated rhetorical framing that blurred explanation with mobilization.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said this appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the clearest 2024 example of a public, relatively truthful de-escalation explanation. | `2B.6`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `Iran’s foreign ministry said nuclear weapons are not part of Iran’s doctrine` | Reuters | 2024-04-22 | [link](https://www.yahoo.com/news/iran-says-nuclear-weapons-no-085328983.html) | Iran publicly denied any nuclear-weapons role in doctrine, and Reuters noted Khamenei’s long-standing fatwa. This is official restraint messaging, but it is declaratory rather than proof that the broader security narrative was fully candid. | `2B.6`, `1B.2`, `1B.4` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike, called it proof of Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. This frames the conflict in prestige and nationalist terms, not just defensive necessity. | `2B.6`, `2B.2`, `2B.3`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | In his first Friday sermon in nearly five years, Khamenei urged allies to intensify resistance against Israel and described strikes as serving the region and humanity. This is strong grievance- and mobilization-based framing, not a neutral threat explanation. | `2B.6`, `2B.2`, `2B.3`, `1B.8`, `1B.6` |
| `Iranian commander warns Tehran could review 'nuclear doctrine' amid Israeli threats` | Reuters | 2024-04-18 | [link](https://www.yahoo.com/news/iranian-commander-warns-tehran-could-114201991.html) | A senior IRGC commander said Israeli threats could lead Tehran to review and deviate from doctrine. This is conditional brinkmanship that amplifies fear and threat perception rather than cleanly separating real danger from political signaling. | `2B.6`, `1B.2`, `1B.3`, `1B.5` |
| `Iran to change nuclear doctrine if existence threatened, adviser to supreme leader says` | Reuters | 2024-05-09 | [link](https://www.dawn.com/news/1832474) | Khamenei adviser Kamal Kharrazi said Iran would alter its nuclear doctrine if its existence were threatened. This ties policy to existential fear and regime-survival logic, which supports a manipulation/instrumental-threat reading. | `2B.6`, `1B.2`, `2B.3`, `1B.6` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors after Iran removed many experienced inspectors. This does not prove public misinformation, but it undercuts any claim of fully transparent or candid security explanation. | `2B.6`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |

**Assessment**

- **Best evidence for truthful explanation:** the April 19 no-retaliation posture and the official denial that nuclear weapons were in doctrine.
- **Best evidence for manipulation:** repeated references to power, resistance, existential threat, and regional struggle, especially in Khamenei’s own April and October statements and in the comments of his close adviser/IRGC commander.
- **Net reading:** he did **not** consistently give the public a purely factual, narrow security explanation. The record instead shows a blend of limited restraint messaging and stronger grievance/threat mobilization.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find direct 2024 evidence of:
  - fabricated intelligence,
  - explicit misinformation campaigns,
  - or a documented false public security claim later disproven by evidence.
- So the strongest supported conclusion is **rhetorical manipulation of fear and grievance**, not proven intelligence falsification.
